definitions.full: H1071. Beker בֶּ֫כֶר proper name, masculine ( young camel , Arabic , Assyrian bakru Asrb Annals ix. 65 ) — 1 son of Ephraim Num 26:35 = בֶּרֶד 1Chr 7:20 . 2 son of Benjamin Gen 46:21 ; 1Chr 7:6 , 8 ( בָּ֑כֶר ).
